'''"Doubler" software''' was a unique [[Computer/Legends|computer]] program utilized by the [[Holographic Projector Doubler Suit]]. The program allowed the [[Armor/Legends|armor]] to create a "[[holo-composite]]" of the target to be duplicated.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
